subject: System Design
title: Read Replicas
description: A quick, practical guide to Read Replicas.

hook.text: Your database handles 50,000 reads per second but only 500 writes. Most traffic is reads.

buildup.text: Read replicas copy data from the primary database. Reads go to replicas; writes stay on the primary.

discovery.text: Adding 4 replicas gives you 5x read capacity without changing your application logic.

twist.text: Replicas have lag. A user writes data, then reads from a replica that hasn't received the write yet.

climax.text: Read replicas are the simplest way to scale reads, but eventual consistency must be managed.

punchline.text: More replicas, more reads — but watch the lag.

quiz.question: What is the main benefit of read replicas?
options: They multiply read capacity across multiple copies
